_comment: Client tool definitions for the ElevenLabs agent (Agent > Tools > Add tool > Client). Both tools run in the Talk page of Open Assistant, so there are no URLs or secrets here. Enable 'Wait for response' on both.

tools.name: ask_assistant
tools.description: Hand a task to the user's personal assistant, which can use their email, calendar, files, the web and other tools. Use it whenever the caller wants something done or looked up. Write a complete, self-contained request. Say a short filler such as 'Let me check that' BEFORE calling. The result has a status: 'done' (read out 'answer'; if 'question' is set, ask it and pass the reply to ask_assistant), 'working' (tell the caller you're still on it, then call check_assistant_result with the job_id) or 'error' (read out 'answer').

parameters.description: The caller's request, rephrased so it makes sense without the earlier conversation.

tools.name: check_assistant_result
tools.description: Collect the result of an earlier ask_assistant call that returned status 'working'. Tell the caller you're still on it first, then call this with the job_id you were given.
